title: `teploy backup head <key> --bytes N --host S --json` (backup-setup-v1, rev 21): the first bytes of a stored object, as stored, through the server's stored target. N is 1 to 262144; a larger N is refused, not clamped. A key outside the server's own and previous prefixes is refused. It never decrypts, so an encrypted object's data_base64 is ciphertext. Refusals and store failures use the error envelope.

length.description: bytes returned; less than requested_bytes when the object is shorter

total_size.description: the whole object's size; null when the store did not say
